title: Pet store
content: A few times I've been to a pet store with unique common animals and unusual "specialty" animals. There's a back room with small pens and bigger animals. It's not incredibly big or deep. I've seen some people describe fish tanks and tile floors with bright florescent lights. I've seen the tanks but not all of them have fish in them. Some have animals. The people always try to help give me an animal I did not come there for. Anyone else been to a pet store?
